text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I haven't run `python3 -m unittest`. I had no command-execution tool here, so I found each bug by reading the code against the tests. Please run the suite to confirm it passes.

- **`fees.py`:** `late_fee` now multiplies days by `DAILY_FEE` instead of adding.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` is now 5 instead of 3.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` now returns exactly the last `n` events. It was returning `n + 1`.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books` now includes the missing `Emma` book.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` now converts the year to an `int`.
- **`search.py`:** it now imports `normalize` from `catalog.text`. It was importing from `catalog.nonexistent`, which doesn't exist.

I also made `recent(0)` return an empty list.

I did not modify the tests.
